column3: The construction of the new office building starts next week. (新辦公大樓的建設將於下週開始。)
The manager decided to suspend the meeting until tomorrow morning. (經理決定將會議暫停至明天早上。)
The computer virus will attack your files if you click that link. (如果你點擊那個連結，電腦病毒將會攻擊你的檔案。)
Don't leave the milk out or it will spoil quickly. (別把牛奶放在外面，否則它很快就會壞掉。)
This hotel has a great reputation for excellent customer service. (這家飯店以優質的客戶服務享有盛譽。)
I suspect that the train will be late today. (我懷疑今天的火車會誤點。)
The jury found him guilty of the crime after the trial. (審判後，陪審團判定他犯下了該罪行。)
The lawyer is busy working on a new legal case. (律師正忙於處理一個新的法律案件。)
Our company decided to outsource the IT support to a local firm. (我們公司決定將 IT 支援外包給一家當地公司。)
We need to cut our travel expenses this year. (我們今年需要削減差旅費用。)
